 Hon'Ble Vinod Diwakar, J.
1 .  Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Smt. Deep Mala Srivastava, learned counsel for the Union of India, and perused the record.

2. Through the instant petition, the petitioner has challenged the impugned order dated 09.07.2024 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hapur, whereby his application seeking issuance of a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the competent court for renewal of passport has been rejected.
3. The case of the petitioner is that he is a qualified medical practitioner and retired as a Medical Officer from the District Hospital, Hapur.
He has been falsely implicated in Case Crime No. 834 of 2018, under Sections 195, 196, 197, & 198 IPC, Police Station Hapur Nagar, District Hapur.

entities.text: Police Station Hapur Nagar, District Hapur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. Aggrieved by the registration of the said FIR, the petitioner preferred an Application U/S 482 No.
13244 of 2019, before this Court, whereby the co-ordinate Bench of this Court was pleased to stay further proceedings in Criminal Case No. 376 of 2019, arising out of aforesaid case crime.

5. It is submitted that when the petitioner approached the passport authorities for renewal of his passport, the same could not be processed in absence of a No Objection Certificate from the trial court where the proceedings are pending.
The trial court, however, declined to issue such NOC by the impugned order dated 09.07.2024, which is under challenge herein.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, and in view of the fact that further proceedings in the criminal case have already been stayed by this Court, there appears to be no legal impediment in allowing the renewal of the petitioner's passport.
7. Accordingly, the impugned order dated 09.07.2024 is hereby set aside.

The trial court is directed to issue a No Objection Certificate (NOC) to the petitioner upon receipt of an application to that effect, preferably within a period of two weeks from the date of presentation of such application.
8. On submission of the said NOC, the passport authorities shall proceed to renew the petitioner's passport strictly in accordance with law.
9. With the aforesaid and directions, the instant petition stands disposed of.

(Vinod Diwakar,J.) November 7, 2025 Anil K. Sharma  Jamal Ahmad Khan vs Union Of India And Another on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44821393/
